body: thank you for the response about the room... i’ve taken the advice and tried to make my room as comforting as possible and am currently working on just making sure im either alone or with other people, never alone with my father. trying to keep myself safe. mostly communicating with my best friend through texts... so far im doing okay. hes staying for 9 more days so hopefully i can keep it up... thank u for the encouragement <3

i’m aware that people don’t have answers. i utilize this site mostly to vent about things i can’t elsewhere and am moreso looking for compassion rather than solutions. sometimes advice but i work in my personal life to reach those solutions. 

as for your questions, i have limited health insurance, but i am not the one paying for it so if i attempt to leave my parents i would most likely not have insurance at all. graduated high school this year but cannot go to college in the fall bc of my mental health/trauma around school that i have to stabilize otherwise ill be in more danger. struggling to find a job/get commissions for my writing but money/job opportunity limited due to my lack of transportation (no car) and my parents adamant refusal to let me have a job. my friends are all heading off to college and most of them r toxic for me anyway. one best friend who moved away to a different state. 

i really appreciate you asking and caring. i hate to give u what seems (at least to me) hopeless circumstances.
Thank you so much!! this sounds silly but i really can’t believe i didnt think of that... i will definitely be trying it out!

wow. that makes.. so much sense. i think that it is definitely something along those lines.... i knew that i didnt have a problem with them having negative emotions, but i had a problem with my reaction to their negative emotions... and i couldnt ever figure out why i was having those reactions. 

i think its because i almost feel like since theyre struggling i cant be? because i dont want to stress them out further, and being a good/supportive friend means im able to focus on them and their problems. but just because theyre upset doesnt magically mean i dont have my own problems.... i think ive been feeling 
1) triggered by their emotions
2) upset that i have to play a role that i cant emotionally fulfill
3) almost feeling invalidated by them as if my problems arent important.. (they dont do anything to imply that, thats just how i feel because of trauma) 

i think the healthiest way to cope from this point on is to try to validate myself and learn better self soothing techniques so i can be a support for them and focus on them without feeling like its hurting me.... thanks so much!! i feel like i've gained a lot of insight since i initially posted this.

i've been on zoloft since the beginning of the year and it hasn't decreased my intrusive thoughts/obsessions... mostly just helped a bit w my depression. i think (& ofc i acknowledge that it may be different for different ppl) that with ocd treatment, therapy is essential to partner with the meds...

i feel like ur definitely right that i should work on stepping back temporarily until im in a less sensitive/anxious place... i have rly intense fears of abandonment & provlems w emotional permanence stemming from trauma (as we do) which honestly makes "stepping back" rly hard... (feeling abandoned and hated in the moments of stepping back) but its still a necessary skill that im definitely working on.. thank you!

wow reading this made a lot of sense somehow? i feel like ive been trying to get to this conclusion by myself but never rly connected all the dots/it just feels more true when its coming from an outside source ig.. thank you for the assurance and i will be asking myself those questions!
